title: Tags leak from one note into the next
prompt:
Users are reporting tags showing up on notes they never tagged. Repro from a fresh session:

    pinned = create_note("Standup", pinned=True)
    plain = create_note("Groceries")
    plain["tags"]   # ['pinned'], expected []

Also, after add_tag(note_a, "work") on one untagged note, other notes created without tags show "work" too, and search.tag_counts counts it for every one of them. Separately, our importer passes one shared list of tags into create_note for a batch of notes, and that list comes back changed (its tags lowercased and "pinned" appended), which corrupts the rest of the batch.

The intended behaviour is in the create_note docstring in notes.py: every note gets its own tags list, the sequence passed in as tags (a list or a tuple) is never modified, and tags are normalized with "pinned" added for pinned notes. Please fix it without changing the function's signature or return shape.
acceptance: Untagged note after a pinned one has no tags; untagged notes do not share a list (add_tag on one leaves the other alone); the caller's list is unchanged after normalization and pinning; tuples are accepted; normalization and the pinned tag still work; tag_counts reflects only real tags.
difficulty_rationale: A single-function bug (a shared mutable default plus in-place modification of the argument) with a clear docstring.
